title: Transport of a derived-limit triangle along an object isomorphism
statement: In a pretriangulated category, a derived-limit triangle remains a derived-limit triangle after transporting its limit object along an isomorphism, with the projection and shifted boundary transported canonically.

source.place: Tag 08TC, transport of distinguished triangles under isomorphism

proof.text: Represent the derived-limit triangle as a distinguished triangle and apply the pretriangulated closure under isomorphic triangles using the vertex isomorphism and identity isomorphisms on the product and shifted product vertices.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib pretriangulated API supplies closure under isomorphic distinguished triangles.

from.place: Categorical transport needed to identify the Roos presentation object with the realized direct-image object

lean.statement: theorem derivedLimitTriangleTransport {C : Type*} [Category C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C] {T : ℕ → C} [HasProduct T] (t : ∀ n, T (n + 1) ⟶ T n) {A B : C} (e : A ≅ B) (p : B ⟶ ∏ᶜ T) (δ : ∏ᶜ T ⟶ B⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (h : IsDerivedLimitTriangle t B p δ) : IsDerivedLimitTriangle t A (e.hom ≫ p) (δ ≫ (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map e.inv)
